title: Amnesty: RSF drone strikes on El Obeid should be investigated as war crimes
detail: Amnesty International called for a war-crimes investigation into RSF drone strikes on El Obeid, North Kordofan. It reviewed nine strikes between June and August 2026 that killed 37 civilians and injured 10, hitting residential areas, a power plant, fuel stations and the main market. It found no military targets nearby. The RSF denied responsibility and blamed the SAF, offering no evidence. Amnesty said it is also investigating SAF drone strikes that caused civilian casualties.

media.caption: Amnesty calls for war crimes probe into RSF drone strikes on El Obeid
